text:
incidentbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty fired a page for service=rdw-inference-eu-embedder (P1). PD-7231. Symptoms: elevated 503s and token latency spikes. Link: https://pagerduty.example/PD-7231
pagerduty: Automated note: page created by alert rule 'embedder-503-fanout' (threshold=5m>5% errors).
vikram: I'm oncall, claiming. starting triage.
leah: support has 3 customer reports (CUST-A, CUST-B, CUST-C) with 5xx in last 6m. forwarding copies.
jamie: quick grep of pod logs shows repeated "KVCache eviction" followed by connection resets on rdw-embedder-0 around 12:01 UTC:
```
E 12:01:10 kvcache: evict keyset, size=1.2G
E 12:01:12 transport: connection reset by peer
```
ops-sre: HPA did not scale — cpu/util metrics show node pressure but pod CPU low. looks like scheduling / node OOMs. investigating node statuses.
vikram: scaling embedder to 6 replicas manually. running: `kubectl scale deploy/rdw-embedder-eu --replicas=6`
emily: manual routing in place: diverting new inference traffic to eu-dedicated-2 pool while we stabilize :arrow_right: eu-dedicated-2 (capacity + isolated).
vikram: after scale + routing, sampled latencies: 1200ms -> 210ms in 3 minutes on health-check traces. error rate down from 7.8% -> 1.2%.
leah: notified affected customers with brief: "we're mitigating; temporary routing applied; engineers on it; ETA ~10m" :email:
riley: filed a quick RCA doc stub (will fill in after full followup). noting possible interaction between kv-cache eviction and node memory thrash.
jamie: node gpu-12 had an OOMKill at 12:00:55; kubelet evicted two pods. suspects kernel oom + driver leak. collecting dmesg and kube events.
ops-sre: attaching snippet of `kubectl describe node gpu-12` output in case we need it for postmortem.
vikram: PD acknowledged -> I'm the primary owner. setting incident state to "monitoring" once we confirm stable for 15m.
incidentbot: PagerDuty: PD-7231 status update: acknowledged by vikram.
leah: customer B asked for timestamp logs; I'll attach server logs and recovery note once we confirm.
vikram: next steps: (1) confirm stability for 15m, (2) spin new nodes with updated driver (if OOM persists), (3) add HPA/oomkube alert tuning to avoid autocascade. will post a follow-up thread for postmortem.
pagerduty: Automated: page transitioned to Acknowledged -> Monitoring.
vikram: closing PD page and moving to monitoring channel. will ping if re-escalation required. :white_check_mark:
incidentbot: PagerDuty: PD-7231 moved to monitoring. Keep watching until 13:00 UTC."
